text: Figure 6.17: Information path for the NVM API request failure The NVRAM manager is notified of an error detected by the subsequent layers during the process of a NVM function or by an internal detection mechanism, write verification static block check, or config ID mismatch (1). Different recovery mechanisms are available at the NVRAM manager level de- pending on the type of function involved, writing or reading (2). If the available recovery mechanisms fail (3), the NVM manager reports NVM_E_REQ_FAILED error to the DEM and sets the job result to NVM_REQ_NOT_OK (4).
